sources.title: INGENIOUS — Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation, DOE Geothermal Data Repository submission 1391
sources.used_for: Official description/license and data inventory for Quaternary faults, 2 m temperature probes, wells/springs, geochemistry, heat flow, geodetics and other regional layers. The page says the compilation is publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0, describes shallow probe temperatures as possible subtle geothermal-anomaly indicators, and lists a 1.03 MB probe ZIP; the local archive was not downloaded or inspected, so its schema, seasonal/sampling metadata and target-footprint coverage remain unknown. sources.title: Ben-David, Blitzer, Crammer, Kulesza, Pereira & Vaughan — A theory of learning from different domains
sources.used_for: Theorem 2 uses source error + one half the empirical HΔH divergence + finite-sample complexity + the ideal joint-hypothesis error λ. Lemma 2 links an optimal symmetric domain discriminator to empirical H-divergence. The paper does not license replacing field-specific source/target definition, λ, VC dimension, or spatial sampling assumptions with an arbitrary random pixel split.
sources.evidence_class: PEER-REVIEWED OPEN-ACCESS ARTICLE; Springer PDF fetched 2026-10-04
